compiled_state.title: [ticket-cli]: ticket create push fails -> 'tickets branch push failed (merge conflict, attempt 1)' with no retry escalation
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## 1. Technical Environment

* **code_version:** e74a751bfe (origin/main HEAD before PR-4 worktree)
* **Skill:** plugins/dso/scripts/ticket (and underlying push retry logic)
* **Tickets worktree HEAD:** a1c0fcc761

## 2. Incident Overview

### Expected Behavior

ticket create writes the new ticket file to the orphan tickets branch, commits, and pushes to origin/tickets. On a push failure (rejected by remote), the retry loop should fetch + rebase/merge + retry until success — or fail loudly if the conflict is unresolvable.

### Actual Behavior

During a session-level audit on 2026-05-28, 5 consecutive ticket create invocations each emitted:

Warning: tickets branch push failed (merge conflict, attempt 1)
Created ticket SLUG (ID): TITLE
ID

The ticket was created locally (slug + ID returned) but the push failed silently with merge conflict at attempt 1. The "attempt 1" wording suggests a retry loop exists but it neither incremented to attempt 2 nor resolved the conflict.

Five ticket IDs filed:
- 34b2-5523-0be0-4945 (P0: check-skill-refs.sh)
- 3706-ae76-0b07-4dfe (P0: qualify-skill-refs.sh)
- a530-53cb-c966-4d46 (P0: check-test-isolation.sh)
- 3bda-755d-c938-4e62 (P2: fixture paths)
- 8229-e80e-4df6-4509 (P2: lint hook)

None of these appear when scanning the recent commits of origin/tickets (latest a1c0fcc761 DELETE 2026-05-29T01-20-41 release lock).

## 3. Action History

5 ticket create invocations sequentially via the ticket CLI. Each returned ticket ID locally; each printed the merge-conflict warning. No remediation attempted yet.

## 4. Root-Cause Hypotheses (informational)

1. Stale local tickets branch ref — push rejected as non-fast-forward, classified as merge conflict
2. Retry counter not incrementing — bug where counter resets every attempt, or only single attempt wired
3. Conflict-resolution path absent — retry only attempts push without pulling/rebasing first
4. Compaction lock interference — release-lock commit suggests compaction lock; push may race against compaction
5. Orphan-branch race — rapid commit churn; another writer (Jira bridge, cleanup, another session) racing the push
6. Push silently failing without ticket loss — local commit exists, but other sessions do not see the new tickets until push succeeds

## 5. Investigation Needed

1. WHY did the push fail (non-fast-forward / merge-conflict / auth / branch protection)
2. WHY did the retry loop not self-heal (attempt 1 only — never attempt 2)
3. WHERE are the 5 just-filed tickets (local-only or successfully synced after the fact)
4. WHAT cleanup is needed to restore consistency

comments.body: Fix shipped on branch fix-12a6-ticket-push-dirty-wd-recovery (commit ea259ecfe3). PR opening via merge-to-main.sh. Operational recovery completed: 343 commits merged + pushed to origin/tickets; all 6 backlogged ticket IDs (this bug + 34b2/3706/a530/3bda/8229) verified present on origin.
